title: CitizenProfile
description: Verified structured citizen profile for scheme matching. Derived from DigiLocker documents or manual self-reporting. No raw document images are stored — only structured fields.

full_name.description: Full legal name of the applicant

age.description: Computed age in years from DOB. Auto-calculated, not user-input.

category.description: Social category. SC = Scheduled Caste, OBC = Other Backward Class. SafaiKaramchari/ManualScavenger/WastePicker are NSKFDC-eligible categories.

domicile_state.description: Indian state code (ISO 3166-2:IN minus 'IN-' prefix, e.g., 'MH' for Maharashtra, 'UP' for Uttar Pradesh). Distinct from live GPS location.

annual_family_income.description: Annual family income in INR (₹) as declared on the income certificate

income_certificate_issue_date.description: Date the income certificate was issued (YYYY-MM-DD). Used for staleness checks.

disability_percentage.description: Certified disability percentage (40%+ is typical threshold for PwD benefits)

existing_loan_flag.description: Whether the applicant has an existing loan from NSFDC/NBCFDC/NSKFDC or their channel partners

is_single_woman.description: Derived field: true if gender=female AND marital_status in (single, widowed, divorced). Relevant for NASY scheme eligibility.

verification_status.description: Whether the profile was verified via DigiLocker or self-reported manually. Downstream modules use this to assess confidence.

needs_reverification.description: True if income certificate is stale (older than 1 financial year) or OBC-NCL certificate needs renewal.

consent_given_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the user consented to data processing. Required for DPDP Act 2023 compliance.

reverification_reason.description: Human-readable reason if needs_reverification is true (e.g., 'Income certificate issued on 2024-03-15 is older than 1 financial year')
